description:
After her family was ruthlessly slaughtered, Mo-ryeon seeks refuge in the home of her father's close friend. However, she spends her lonely days in sorrow, feeling like an outsider without roots. In those hopeless days, a shadow leaps over the wall and sneaks into her room. 'I'm here, Mo-ryeon.' With a languid smile, he crawls under her skirt. People would never know how persistent and lewd Han Yu-baek—the man they all praise—truly is. 'Were you trying to run away to a place where I am not? You can never escape my embrace. Not then, not now, and not ever.'
